tools.name: search_rooms
tools.description: Search approved, available student rooms by budget, type, university, optional campus, distance, and features. Results include public listing content submitted by UniAffitti users.

tools.name: rank_room_matches
tools.description: Find public, approved room listings and score them against preferences such as budget, campus distance, room type, and trust signals. Listing content is submitted by UniAffitti users.

tools.name: get_room_details
tools.description: Return public details for one approved room, including user-submitted description, media, features, and limited landlord trust information.

tools.name: compare_rooms
tools.description: Compare selected public room listings side by side for price, distance, type, availability, features, and trust signals.

tools.name: list_search_metadata
tools.description: List a paginated slice of the global university catalog, optional campuses, and feature filters for room search. The catalog is not limited to 500 records.

tools.name: search_universities
tools.description: Search the complete active UniAffitti university catalog worldwide with pagination and total count.

tools.name: search_cities
tools.description: Search cities represented in the active university catalog and public room listings, with country and university counts for assisted room search.

tools.name: list_university_campuses
tools.description: List active campuses for a selected university so the user can refine the room search.

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: When the user asks to access or connect UniAffitti, call this tool. It starts secure OAuth account connection when needed, then returns only first and last name, email, role, and email-verification status; it does not return phone, photos, account IDs, credentials, or secrets.

tools.name: list_my_messages
tools.description: Read the authenticated user’s UniAffitti conversations from the same chat used by the web app. Without a conversation_id return fast conversation summaries and last-message previews; with one load the complete recent messages for that conversation.

tools.name: send_room_message
tools.description: Send and permanently store a message to the landlord of an approved available room from the authenticated UniAffitti account. The landlord receives a notification; messages cannot be recalled with this tool. Do not include passwords, payment-card details, government identifiers, health or biometric

tools.name: get_my_conversation_messages
tools.description: Load the recent messages for one authenticated UniAffitti conversation. This is a data-only tool intended to be called by the messages UI after the user selects a conversation.

tools.name: list_my_favorites
tools.description: List the authenticated user’s saved available rooms.

tools.name: add_favorite
tools.description: Save an approved room to the authenticated user’s favorites.

tools.name: remove_favorite
tools.description: Remove a room from the authenticated user’s favorites.

tools.name: list_my_requests
tools.description: List rental requests sent or received by the authenticated user.

tools.name: create_rental_request
tools.description: Create and send a rental request for an approved available room using the authenticated UniAffitti account. The landlord is notified, and the request remains in the account until its status changes. Do not include passwords, payment-card details, government identifiers, health or biometric data in t

tools.name: update_rental_request_status
tools.description: Change a rental request to in review, accepted, rejected, or cancelled according to the authenticated user’s role. Acceptance marks the room as rented; status changes may notify the other participant.

tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: List the authenticated user’s own listings and moderation status.

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Create a listing draft for UniAffitti moderation. It is not public until approved. The draft stores the full property address and coordinates; university and campus IDs remain unset. Do not include passwords, payment-card details, government identifiers, health or biometric data in the description.

tools.name: get_account_links
tools.description: Return deep links for account, listing creation, messages, requests, and favorites in the full UniAffitti web app.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_profile, list_my_messages, get_my_conversation_messages, get_account_links · Private data: list_search_metadata, get_my_profile, send_room_message, create_rental_request, create_listing · Public sink: get_my_profile, send_room_message, create_rental_request, update_rental_request_status · Destructive: remove_favorite.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_my_profile, list_my_messages, get_my_conversation_messages, get_account_links · Private data: list_search_metadata, get_my_profile, send_room_message, create_rental_request, create_listing · Public sink: get_my_profile, send_room_message, create_rental_request, update_rental_request_status · Destructive: remove_favorite

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
